A recent update to the metadata resulted in widespread API call failures. Which Salesforce feature would allow administrators to quickly revert to the previous working configuration?
answers: Change Sets
Package Versions
Metadata API via Workbench
Data Export and Import
feedbacks: Change sets are used for deployments, not quick rollbacks of data.
Package versions manage the deployment of packaged components, not custom metadata record rollbacks.
While Metadata API can be used, it's not the fastest method for a quick revert by an admin.
This requires exporting old metadata values which might be slow or error prone.
questions.explanation: Data Export and Import to extract the old version followed by importing it back in to the organization.

questions.question: A Salesforce organization has a complex sharing model, including multiple sharing rules based on custom fields. A user reports they cannot see a record they believe they should have access to. Which of the following is the MOST efficient way to troubleshoot the user's record access?
answers: Debug Logs
Sharing Hierarchy
Sharing Settings Page
Why I Can't Access This Record
feedbacks: Debug logs will capture user events but are not efficient for diagnosing sharing issues.
Sharing Hierarchy is not an existing troubleshooting tool.
The sharing settings page only shows sharing rules and default settings, not actual record access.
The Why I Can't Access This Record button/tool provides information specific to record access without delving into complex details.
questions.explanation: 'Why I Can't Access This Record' gives the precise sharing access information for a user on the specific record.

questions.question: A large organization implements Salesforce Knowledge. Articles need to be translated into multiple languages. Which combination of features is BEST suited to automate the translation process while maintaining consistency?
answers: Translation Workbench
Knowledge Settings
Translation Management API
Article Types and Layout
Global Picklists
AI-Powered Translation Service
feedbacks: The Translation Workbench handles manual translation, not automated processes.
Knowledge settings configure various Knowledge features but doesn't provide translation automation.
The Translation Management API facilitates automated translations via a system, and is a valid answer.
Article Types and Layout is for structuring content and not for translation.
Global Picklists can assist with translations but are not sufficient.
AI powered translation service, integrated with Salesforce, would handle the automation process.
questions.explanation: Utilizing the Translation Management API and an integrated AI-Powered Translation Service will provide a scalable and automated translation process.

questions.question: A Salesforce org has a custom object 'Project' with a Master-Detail relationship to 'Account'. Users need to create related 'Project' records directly from the 'Account' record page. Additionally, they need to be able to quickly add multiple 'Project' records at once. Which method is MOST efficient to achieve this?
answers: Custom Button with URL Hack
Custom Lightning Web Component
Related List with New Button
Custom Visualforce Page with a Controller
feedbacks: URL Hacks are not recommended, are unsupportable, and also do not accommodate multiple record creation.
Custom LWC could achieve this but is unnecessarily complex for this simple need.
Related List offers functionality that supports single record creation not multiple.
While Visualforce can do bulk record creation it is not the MOST efficient option.
questions.explanation: Visualforce page will handle this scenario with ease, including creating multiple records and redirecting back to account.
